metadata.description: RTD plugin marketplace for Claude Code

plugins.name: oberskills
plugins.description: Prompt engineering, agent dispatch enforcement, skill creation and review, screenshot analysis, web search, and writing that doesn't sound like a robot wrote it. The skills I use every day, bundled up.

plugins.name: code-foundations
plugins.description: Software engineering habits pulled straight from the books that actually changed how I write code. Checklist-driven review, debugging, whiteboarding, and gates that keep quality honest.

plugins.name: design-for-ai
plugins.description: A four-stage design workflow, research, plan, mock, build, built on real doctrine instead of vibes. Seeded composition dealer, user-pinnable axes, dual-blind review, and gated artifacts so nothing ships half-baked.

plugins.name: react-native-foundations
plugins.description: Everything I reach for on React Native: docs search, iOS Simulator control, error diagnosis, runtime debugging, layout checks, accessibility audits, and coding guidance that's actually current.

plugins.name: svelte-foundations
plugins.description: The same kit for Svelte and SvelteKit: docs search, browser automation over CDP, error diagnosis, coding guidance, and accessibility audits.

plugins.name: claude-mux
plugins.description: An MCP server for tmux, so an agent can spawn workers, talk to them, share task lists, and run whole tmux sessions without me babysitting it.

plugins.name: grug-brain
plugins.description: Persistent memory for LLMs. FTS5 search, docs indexing, a dreaming pass, and brain sync across machines, all stored as plain markdown you can read and git-track yourself.

plugins.name: penman
plugins.description: Paste markdown, get it looking right everywhere: Slack, Teams, Discord, Notion, Word, Outlook, Gmail, Confluence, Jira, PowerPoint. Copies styled HTML straight to your clipboard, ready to paste.

plugins.name: fable-bench
plugins.description: Hand a hard call or a wide-open brainstorm to a Fable 5 subagent under a curated discipline brief. judge-fable renders the verdict, muse-fable spreads the ideas, and only the distilled result comes back. The deliberation stays in the sub-thread.

plugins.name: systems-design
plugins.description: Frameworks I use for system design interviews and architecture review, built for distributed systems, not generic advice.
